name: month-bars
title: Month Bars
description: Spending by month: bars rise in turn, the picked month lights teal and the figure counts to it.

perf.budget: Bars use short UI-thread springs on arrival; the figure re-renders only while it counts. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Bars appear in place and the figure changes without counting.
a11y.screenReader: The figure reads as one line ("OCT: $2,316.30, +129.11") and each month as a button with its selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: Each month is the full column, at least 44 pt tall.
